purpose: Durable accepted product-specific architecture decisions derived from explicit user intent. Execution state does not override context docs or active specs.

decisions.title: Public content is not the marketing domain
decisions.decision: Static landing, features, pricing, FAQ, contact, terms, privacy, and similar pages belong to app/(public). Marketing names the marketing-automation business domain.

decisions.title: Public demo browseability is separate from mutation authority
decisions.decision: Signed-out visitors may browse seeded/read-only demo surfaces across recipe domains. Real protected mutations still require server authentication, application authorization, tenant/resource scope, validation, and RLS where applicable.

decisions.title: React Hook Form feature exception
decisions.decision: Normal features compose blocks. React Hook Form feature forms are self-contained and compose UI primitives directly; form blocks are not required.

decisions.title: Use canonical domain vocabulary
decisions.decision: Use crm, projects, support, marketing, invoicing, social, ai, portal, admin, user, common across repository organization where applicable.

decisions.title: Blocks are grouped pure presentation categories
decisions.decision: components/blocks is a BoldKit-like catalog organized by presentation category with useful named variations. Blocks do not own form state, auth, provider, database, or workflow logic.

decisions.title: Functional application library classifier
decisions.decision: All persisted reads use fetchers; ordinary CRUD writes use actions; selects/DTOs/transactions live in lib/db; Clerk in auth; RBAC/ABAC in authz; provider behavior in integrations except Clerk/Neon/Prisma; webhook HTTP lifecycle in app/api; remaining domain logic in shallow workflows.

decisions.title: Dark-only mature neo-brutalist design
decisions.decision: The Maximal Template is dark-only with charcoal/near-black surfaces, off-white text, strong borders, restrained accents, squared geometry, controlled hard shadows, dense typography, and mechanical motion. Cartoonish candy neo-brutalism is rejected.

decisions.title: Admin is a real URL domain
decisions.decision: Admin routes live beneath a real admin path segment so /admin/users, /admin/records, and /admin/audit resolve correctly. A route group may not erase the required URL segment.

decisions.title: CRM contacts is the golden vertical slice
decisions.decision: Normalize CRM contacts first as the reference list/detail/new/edit + fetcher/action/schema/type/select/DTO/auth/authz/RLS/Suspense pattern before broad recipe normalization.

decisions.title: Provider work follows core architecture stabilization
decisions.decision: Complete providers after architecture, routes, design, blocks, golden slice, library normalization, and explorer shell. Preferred order is Stripe, Blob/Cloudinary, SendGrid, Hugging Face.

decisions.title: Product-specific doctrine specializes reusable Knowledge System doctrine
decisions.decision: The Codependent Coding Knowledge System supplies the governance model and reusable doctrine. Explicit Maximal Template context/specs control deliberate product-specific specializations and may reject generic optional layers such as query/command/webhook service structures.

decisions.title: Domain implementation must match business workflows
decisions.decision: Owner explicitly rejects repeated generic stats/table/summary pages, command echoes, and local review-only forms. Domain templates own distinct workflow compositions; real forms call validated protected persistence. Static evidence is separate from live CRUD/provider evidence.
